freeze_boundary: Draft only. Materializes exactly the ID-001 acceptance rule (key scope includes workspace and operation; payload-hash mismatch is a conflict) and the API-002 rule (same key with the same payload returns the same result; a different payload conflicts). The conflict is expressed through CTR-ERR-001 category `conflict`; the store implementation, lock strategy, retention window, and HTTP header name are NOT inferred and remain open before freeze.

Uses blake3 rather than sha256. The contract names no algorithm, so this MUST be accepted. It exists so the schema/predicate agreement guard is not vacuous: an earlier version of this package deleted the sha256 pin from the schema while leaving it running in the acceptance predicate, and no fixture could tell the difference. Reintroducing that pin now makes this fixture fail.
